focal_point: A large headline on gold, with a parent-and-child photo as the emotional stop.
eye_path: Z across the headline into the photo, stopped by a legal band.
grid: Diagonal split plus a full-width legal band.
scale_ratios: Headline is the hero. The dollar ceiling sits inside the sentence, not as a numeral hero.
type_choices: One sans. Legal line is as heavy as display. About four sizes.
photo_art_direction: Stock parent and child, mutual gaze, warm window light. Cheerful and generic.
offer_placement: The deal is the headline on gold. It works. Legal type flattens the bottom.
trust_and_cta: Code, URL, and phone share one white card. The card is a real lockup.
emulate: Offer as one sentence on a color field. QR, link, and phone in a single quiet card.
do_not_copy: The equity mark and the disclaimer wording.
summary: Mailbox equity card. One sentence works. The legal strip is too loud.
